topic: Data model updates and time zone issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several data pipeline issues. Initially, a request was made to regenerate the model for specific dates (2023-03-01) due to an accidental failure after upgrading ClickHouse.

Later, the discussion focused on time zone discrepancies, particularly concerning Brazilian locations and inventory data. It was noted that while Brazilian users see correct local times by default, the system needs proper facility time zones for accurate dashboard display across all regions.

Improvements were discussed, including a new dedicated cluster structure for experimental features (like those in Hong Kong) to ensure stability and scalability.
decisions: The data model was regenerated/recalculated for 2023-03-01.
A task will be created to improve the inventory list by adding better identification for multiple facilities within Brazil.
A dedicated, powerful cluster structure is being planned for experimental features.
action_items: Someone needs to address the missing time zone data for various facilities/inventory locations (especially in Brazil) to ensure accurate dashboard reporting.
A task was created for searching/improving facility location details (DOOH-85).
